content: 1. The American Heart Association Stroke Council and the Council on Epidemiology and Prevention published a comprehensive statement in April 2011 titled Diagnosis and Management of Cerebral Venous Thrombosis: A Statement for Healthcare Professionals from the American Heart Association/American Stroke Association. This document was featured in the journal Stroke: A Journal of Cerebral Circulation, Volume 42, Issue 4, spanning pages 1158–1192. The publication is identified by the DOI 10.1161/STR.0b013e31820a8364, ISSN 1524-4628, and PMID 21293023. 2. Ebright J., Pace M., and Niazi A.F. authored a study titled Septic Thrombosis of the Cavernous Sinuses, which was published on December 10, 2001, in the Archives of Internal Medicine. This article appeared in Volume 161, Issue 22, on pages 2671–2676. The publication is associated with ISSN 0003-9926 and PMID 11732931. 3. The Infectious Diseases Society of America released clinical practice guidelines on February 1, 2011, titled Clinical Practice Guidelines by the Infectious Diseases Society of America for the Treatment of Methicillin-Resistant Staphylococcus aureus Infections in Adults and Children. This guideline was published in Clinical Infectious Diseases: An Official Publication of the Infectious Diseases Society of America, Volume 52, Issue 3, on pages e18–e55. The publication is identified by the DOI 10.1093/cid/ciq146, ISSN 1537-6591, and PMID 21208910.
